d:
Kaee log lo ke profeshan men aane ka sapna dekhte hain. iske lie is propheshan se jure korsez, achchhe kolej ka pata hona bhi jaruri hai. kors pura karne ke bad naukri pane ke lie achchha tarika kya hai aur is phild ke propheshnals kitni sailri kama sakte hain, in savalon ka javab bhi janna jaruri hai. kariyar kanekt ke is episod men lo ke peshe se jure aise hi zaruri savalon ke javab janenge.
Prodyusar kirti rajora aur bharat sharma
Vidiyoh jamshaid ali
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
